    # B = [-1008, 1007], |B| = 2016
    
    A_min, A_max = -999, 1000
    B_min, B_max = -1008, 1007
    D_max = 1000
    
    K = 0
    for m in range(A_min, A_max + 1):
        # We need n such that |m - n| <= 1000, so m - 1000 <= n <= m + 1000
        
        lower_bound_req = m - D_max
        upper_bound_req = m + D_max
        
        # n must be in B and satisfy the required range
        n_start = max(B_min, lower_bound_req)
        n_end = min(B_max, upper_bound_req)
        
        if n_end >= n_start:
            k_m = n_end - n_start + 1
            K += k_m
            
    return K

print(calculate_K())
